headline: UnitedHealth's Q3 Margins Improve, But Membership Falls: Time to Buy?
summary: UNH's Q3 earnings surge and improving margins signal a recovery, but falling membership and elevated utilization raise questions about sustained growth.

headline: Where Could UnitedHealth's Next Growth Come From?
summary: UnitedHealth Group (UNH) could find its next growth engine in the care it delivers. That perspective carries weight right now. During the company's October 13 call, management raised its 2026 outlook to adjusted earnings per share of at least $20.50. Yet executives also warned that medical costs remain stubbornly high across health care. So which part of UnitedHealth's care business still has room to grow.

headline: Centene Corporation Demonstrates Commitment to CHOICE Arrangements through Benefit Programs in Indiana, Ohio and Oklahoma
summary: Centene Corporation (NYSE: CNC), a leading healthcare enterprise committed to helping people live healthier lives, announced the expansion of its CHOICE Arrangements benefit program (formerly ICHRA) to employees in Ohio and Oklahoma for plan year 2027. Building on the successful implementation of the program for Indiana-based employees in 2026, the expansion reflects Centene's ongoing commitment to providing employees with greater flexibility and choice in their health coverage.
